answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 59555 Country: Pakistan Title: Taking a debt from someone whose income is doubtful or is from haram sources Question: I took a loan from someone who is a government employee and I know that his income is not entirely halal. Moreover when I took the loan he borrowed some money from some other people and gave to me. The total amount that he loaned me included some of his income and some that he borrowed from other people. The entire loan is interest free. That is why I took it. But I have some doubts. Therefore, I want to know is such a loan permissible or halal. If haram in which cases we can take it? Answer ID: 59555 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 987/1002/L=08/1436) Be not suspicious. When he is a government employee and there is no doubt in his employment then there is no harm in taking debt from him. However, if his total income or most of the income is received from illegitimate source then it is not correct to take debt from him. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
